confidenceOnlyVariant.description: Keep the existing 0.03 magnitude anchor and weights, but multiply the disagreement contribution by agreement confidence.

heat.finding: Do not broadly rescale Heat magnitude to the current-period p75. The existing 0.03 magnitude anchor is healthier. Any Heat recalibration should be limited to moderating the disagreement contribution when agreement confidence is weak.

pressure.finding: Pressure is genuinely center-heavy, but 19 reports have an exact neutral reading and should remain neutral. A modest expansion in the 1500-2000 range or a smooth tanh transform is defensible; forcing equal thirds would create false directional pressure.

confidenceShrinkVariant.description: Shrink score toward 50 according to evidence confidence.
confidenceShrinkVariant.result: Over-compresses the meter around 50 and does not solve the missing-evidence classification problem.

agreement.finding: Agreement is primarily an evidence-confidence problem, not a scale problem. A raw score of 50 can mean neutral agreement or no cohesion data. Production should not classify no-evidence 50 as HIGH agreement.
